RSF_MANAGEMENT_APPLICATION_ID <- "4608A309E2E38860DC98FAC53F967CF2"

ACCOUNT_SYS_CALCULATOR <- do.call(
  db_user_login,
  append(list(pool=scheduleApps,
              application_hashid=RSF_MANAGEMENT_APPLICATION_ID),
         yaml.load_file(here::here("credentials","credentials-account-rsf-sys-calculator.yaml"))))


scheduleCalcEnv <- rsf_calculations_initialize_enivonment(dremioConnect())
schedulePool <- dbStart(database=DATABASE_LOCATION)

## Job globalReporting

```{r}

  if (isTRUE(IS_DEPLOYED)) {
    
    message("RUNNING do_global_reporting()")
    
    updates <- dbGetQuery(schedulePool,"
    select p_rsf.do_global_reporting()::bool as current")
    
  } else {
    message("NOT DEPLOYED: skipping do_global_reporting()")
  }

```

## Job pendingCalculations

```{r }
pending_calcs <- 0
if (isTRUE(IS_DEPLOYED)) {
  message("RUNNING do_pendingCalculations()")
  
  pending_calcs <- do_pendingCalculations(schedulePool = schedulePool,
                                          scheduleCalcEnv = scheduleCalcEnv)

} else {
  message("NOT DEPLOYED: skipping do_pendingCalculations()")
}

```

##Completed: `r pending_calcs` pending calculations

### Finalizing Jobs
```{r complete, message=FALSE }

scheduleCalcEnv$closeConnections()

poolClose(schedulePool)
poolClose(scheduleApps)

scheduleCalcEnv <- NULL
schedulePool <- NULL
scheduleApps <- NULL

```
